newsitem.title: CANADA: Teck announces debentures, gain on DFR. [CORRECTED 21:53 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Teck announces debentures, gain on DFR. [CORRECTED 21:53 GMT]

text.p: Teck Corp said on Thursday it raised C$238 million on closing of the sale of 25-year three percent debentures convertible to shares of Inco Ltd.
The company added it had determined the gain on its 10.4 precent stake in Diamond Fields Resources Ltd, which was acquired by Inco in a deal that closed last month.

The stake totaled C$73 million in cash as well as Inco preferred E shares with a current market value of C$78 million and Voisey's Bay Nickel Co shares with a current market value of C$120 million, the company said.

He said that as a result, Teck's cash position was C$450 million and marketable share investments amounted to a further C$280 million. The amount did not include Cominco Ltd and other long-term holdings. (Corrects name of company.)
The proceeds of the debenture sales would be used to finance capital expenditures and for general corporate purposes, Teck has said.
